verdict.rationale: Nix's `nix-shell`/`nix develop`/`nix build` commands build or download all declared dependencies from a flake or shell.nix and drop the developer into a fully-provisioned environment, and community testimony corroborates this working reliably in production teams. missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark of a true one-command fresh-clone bootstrap end-to-end, and no mention of edge-case failures during first-time setup.
